create_time.Description: Output only. The creation timestamp of the view.

filter.Description: Filter that restricts which log entries in a bucket are visible in this view. Filters are restricted to be a logical AND of ==/!= of any of the following: - originating project/folder/organization/billing account. - resource type - log id For example: SOURCE("projects/myproject") AND resource.type = "gce_instance" AND LOG_ID("stdout")

location.Description: The location of the resource. The supported locations are: global, us-central1, us-east1, us-west1, asia-east1, europe-west1.

name.Description: The resource name of the view. For example: \'projects/my-project/locations/global/buckets/my-bucket/views/my-view\'

update_time.Description: Output only. The last update timestamp of the view.
